units.source_text: 也许他这是为了向我展示我所想像不到的地的另一个侧面，才专程前来的吧。

en.t: Perhaps he had gone out of his way to come there in order to show me another side of the place, one I could never have imagined.

units.source_text: 这个只对美的冒渎感兴趣的、好挖苦人的柏木，确实让我看到了他纤细的另一个侧面。

en.t: This Kashiwagi, who was interested only in the profanation of beauty and loved to make sarcastic remarks, had indeed shown me another, delicate side of himself.

units.source_text: 他对美所持的理论，远比我更为精密。

en.t: The theory he held about beauty was far more precise than mine.

units.source_text: 对于这种理论，他不是用语气，而是用姿态、眼神、吹奏尺八的曲调和伸向月光中的前额来表达。

en.t: He expressed this theory not through his tone of voice, but through his posture, his gaze, the melody he played on the shakuhachi, and his forehead extended into the moonlight.
